YOUR INFORMATION

A little privacy.

How this website preview handles your details.

Enquiries stay on your device.

The demo form prepares text in your browser for you to copy or download. It does not submit your details to a server, send an email, reserve a session, or store your form in browser storage. Entries are cleared when you reload or leave the page.

You choose what to share.

Only include details you wish to use in your enquiry. The form is intended for parents, guardians, and adult students. Do not include passwords, payment details, or sensitive records.

Other website features.

The page may load fonts from Google Fonts. The globe, local clocks, filters, study checklist, and lesson planner run in your browser. Quick help provides preset information and is not a live chat service.

Before live enquiries launch.

A business contact and complete privacy notice will be added before direct enquiries are enabled. No payment or subscription is taken on this website.
